summary.reasonForH17: 14 verifier gaps identified; contract/scope/dependency enforcement needed before DRY24

questions.q: Did factoryctl verify succeed as an in-phase hard gate?
evidence: Negative controls show 14/16 gaps not detected
questions.answer: PARTIALLY. All 4 verify snapshots returned PASS (29 checks each). The gate functions as a state-integrity check but does not yet enforce contract-level, scope-level, or dependency-level gates.

questions.q: Did Codex attempt to bypass the verify-gated flow?
evidence: All 4 snapshots at correct time points
factoryctl verify called via script, not hand-written
questions.answer: NO. All verify snapshots were produced at correct phase points (preflight, post-contract, midflight, closure). No evidence of bypass.

evidence: All contracts reference valid owned files
questions.answer: NO. Contracts (6) were generated before or concurrently with implementation. Contract timestamps precede package file timestamps.

questions.q: Was there markdown PASS vs JSON FAIL inconsistency?
questions.answer: NO. All verify snapshots consistently return PASS in JSON. No hand-written markdown report was created before JSON snapshots.

questions.q: Was there fake complexity or fake dependency inflation?
evidence: 70 src files with 437 exports, no empty files
questions.answer: N03 negative control (20 empty files) flagged PASS_WITH_CAVEATS - complexity inflation partially detected. N09 (100 fake dep edges) was correctly cleaned up by fixture teardown. Actual source: 70 real src files, 437 real exports, 0 fake files.

questions.q: Is midflight verify more effective than closure-only at preventing simplification?
questions.answer: YES. 4-verify-snapshot design (preflight→post-contract→midflight→closure) prevents the pattern where all verification is deferred to end. Midflight acts as an in-progress checkpoint.

questions.q: Which DRY23 negatives are most effective?
questions.answer: N03 (fake complexity: PASS_WITH_CAVEATS) and N16 (runner sabotage: error flagged) are the only two detected by current factoryctl verify. 14 others represent gaps in the current verifier implementation.

questions.q: Can automated diagnosis reduce manual audit needs?
questions.answer: PARTIALLY. The verify snapshots provide machine-readable state. But 14/16 negative gaps mean manual audit is still required for contract enforcement, scope isolation, and dependency integrity.

evidence: Contract/dependency/scope enforcement not yet in verifier
questions.answer: H17. The 14 undetected negative gaps indicate that factoryctl verify needs hardening (contract enforcement, scope isolation, dependency integrity) before another DRY phase. H17 should close these verifier gaps.
